evidence_limits.statement: Remaining counts and counter changes do not identify who held the zone or why a counter changed. They are not evidence of zone control, of pushing or losing the objective, or of the count causing the death.
No penalty was visible where one side's count_before_progress is 0; a missed penalty read would make it larger. Penalty never counts toward the result.
Team-level control transitions do not identify which player caused a capture or loss, and do not prove causation.
map_check_before_death means any map overlay occurred before the death (unbounded lookback); it is not evidence of a recent check or map-usage quality.

Roster (ally/opponent alive count) evidence is not used for coaching: it has not passed the reliability bar. Do not state alive counts, numbers advantage or disadvantage, teammate availability, or who was last alive.

playback_clock.reason: Median of 138349 timer pair slopes: 1.000 game s per video s (tolerance 0.1).
